trigger: User rejected the installed before/after comparison as visually unnatural.
visible_failures: Eye04 lost fine eyelid and iris detail and developed heavy dark contours.
Mirrored light and ink structure made the expression rigid despite equal geometry.
Other two eyes and all three brows changed original brushwork, density or expression.

source_findings.eye04: Original left eye was interpolated to form a guide; image generation changed its brushwork; native output was bilinearly registered and then sampled once more before exact reflection.
source_findings.other_five: Regenerated native outputs were each registered with one bilinear sample; the native brushwork was already different.
source_findings.runtime: Actual compositor retains1024x1536 and uses zero-offset BlendRect; no extra PNG downsize caused this loss.
source_findings.diagnostic_limits: High-frequency comparisons locate softness in the chain; changed shape and Alpha prevent treating these numbers as aesthetic scores.

corrective_action: Withdraw six redraws and restore approved frozen original RGBA by exact integer whole-pair horizontal translation, with no interpolation, generation, reflection, scaling or rotation.
remaining_work: Original local left/right eye and brow shape differences are retained; restoration must not be described as complete symmetry correction.
process_correction: A geometry or runtime pass cannot approve brushwork, expression or clarity. Review normal-size rendered faces against the original before installation; reject any visual regression.
